about.title: About Us
about.whatIsPara1: Yumurcak is a daycare tracking app developed to make communication between daycares and parents more organized, faster, and more transparent.
about.whatIsPara2: Parents can easily follow their child's daily reports, attendance status, meal list, announcements, events, gallery posts, and development information all in one place.
about.whatIsPara3: Teachers and administrators manage classroom processes more practically, deliver instant information to parents, and strengthen internal organization.
about.whatIsPara4: Yumurcak's goal is to convey a child's day at daycare to families in a clearer, safer, and warmer way.
about.approachPara1: Yumurcak was designed to offer a simple, clear, and easy-to-use experience.
about.approachPara2: Our goal is not to build complicated screens, but to deliver the information daycares, teachers, and parents genuinely need in the easiest way possible.
about.approachPara3: Every child's day matters. We aim to convey that day to families in a more organized, reliable, and heartfelt way.
